newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Q Data shares jump on good H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Q Data shares jump on good H1 results.

text.p: Shares in Q Data leapt on Monday in early trade buoyed by better-than-expected results released early this morning, dealers said.

They said electronic stocks eased last week after players took a negative view on International Business Machines Corp results last week. Q Data results were also expected to be poor and its share price suffered last week.
"There was a perception that their results would be down and their share price was knocked last week. They (results) are not great but they are better than expected," a dealer said.
Q Data shares leapt to a high of 10.95 before settling at 10.60 rand at 0958 GMT -- 3.92 percent higher. Volumes were high with over 317,000 shares changing hands worth over 3.3 million rand.
Dealers said there was still upward potential for the share price with its P.E. ratio at 48.
They said other electronic stocks had higher P.E. ratios than Q Data. Dimesion Data Holdings is at a P.E. ratio of 75, Persetel Holdings is at 71, Datatech is at 61 and Q Data is at 48.
"There is no reason for Q Data to lag behind. It is either the others come down or Q Data goes up. The way I see it Q-data will go up," another dealer said, adding that 12 rand to 12.50 was in sight.
